newsitem.title: PERU: Peru rebel leaves Lima hostages talks.
newsitem.headline: Peru rebel leaves Lima hostages talks.

text.p: Talks between Marxist rebels holding 72 hostages at the Japanese ambassador's home in Lima and the Peruvian government apparently ended after about four hours on Tuesday.

A white Red Cross car that had transported a member of the Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement (MRTA) to a safe house for the talks was seen by witnesses making the journey back to the besieged residence.

Two of the mediators for the talks, Vatican representative Juan Luis Cipriani and Canadian Ambassador Anthony Vincent, left the building a few moments later and told reporters the two sides had agreed on further negotiations at a later date.

Peruvian President Alberto Fujimori said earlier on Tuesday that he hoped the preliminary talks with the rebel's deputy leader Rolly Rojas would pave the way for formal talks with MRTA chief Nestor Cerpa Cartolini to end the crisis.
